mapper.select: SELECT FROM bike_vehicle v JOIN bike_station s ON s.id=v.station_id WHERE v.id=#{id}
SELECT id,vehicle_no,station_id,status,description,created_at,updated_at FROM bike_vehicle WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT v.id,v.vehicle_no,v.station_id,s.name AS station_name FROM bike_vehicle v JOIN bike_station s ON s.id=v.station_id WHERE v.status='idle' AND s.status='enabled' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bike_rental_order o WHERE o.vehicle_id=v.id AND o.status IN ('ongoing','exception')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bike_repair_order r WHERE r.vehicle_id=v.id AND r.status IN ('pending','processing')) AND v.vehicle_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{vehicleNo},'%') AND v.station_id=#{stationId} ORDER BY v.id DESC
SELECT id,name FROM bike_station WHERE status='enabled' ORDER BY name,id
SELECT status FROM bike_station WHERE id=#{stationId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_rental_order WHERE vehicle_id=#{vehicleId} AND status IN ('ongoing','exception')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_repair_order WHERE vehicle_id=#{vehicleId} AND status IN ('pending','processing')
